positions.name: MeridianDeploymentGateVerification
positions.frame: what verification requirements and governance gates apply to Meridian release train deployments?
positions.why: Quinton mandates a signed release manifest for all Meridian deployments (src-2) and grounds the necessity of the gate in the preceding quarter's occurrence of unsigned artifacts reaching staging (src-3). The accompanying summary notes record the operational gate requirement (src-4), define its scope across staging and production environments (src-5), and confirm single-owner accountability under Quinton Fairweather (src-6).
